args.integrator:
ROLE: INTEGRATOR of round 3 + the water lane into lane int2. Time box 90 min. WORK = $SP/work_p4/int2; mirror LOG + patches into MAIN/notes/round11/lane_backup/p4int2/.
INPUTS (read each lane's HANDOFF.md and its final verdict in MAIN/notes/round11/lane_backup/p4r3/{rejudge_,judge_}p4<lane>/ and p4r2/rejudge_p4water/):
- water (round 2, base aa8; int1's Water.ts == aa8's): MAIN/notes/round11/lane_backup/p4r2/p4water/p4water_vs_aa8.patch (Water.ts only, sha256 902ee34f...); lane LANES/p4water.
- ice3 (base int1): MAIN/notes/round11/lane_backup/p4r3/p4ice3/p4ice3_vs_int1.patch (sha256 346fbd43...); lane LANES/p4ice3.
- orb3 (base int1): .../p4r3/p4orb3/p4orb3_vs_int1.patch (Orb.ts, Shards.ts; sha256 dbaa2620...); lane LANES/p4orb3.
- env3 (base int1): .../p4r3/p4env3/p4env3_vs_int1.patch (sha256 c58e6df7...) + its public/hero asset(s) (int1 vs LANES/p4env3/retrux-web/public: e.g. Object_2_010_p4q.webp - copy every new / changed asset, list sha256 + sizes); lane LANES/p4env3.
- atmos (base int1): .../p4r3/p4atmos/p4atmos_vs_int1.patch (HeroEngine.ts, PlateEnvironment.ts, new p4atmos.ts; sha256 89cfec29...); lane LANES/p4atmos. LEAD DECISION: ship atmos WITHOUT its new hold fog bank: its rejudge found N1 (a straight light stripe with a darker gap in the hold bank and a straight streak at the release snap). Make MAIN's hold bank and release the default in int2 by flipping the default of the lane's `?fogbank` switch (default = r11 behaviour; `?fogbank=p4` turns the new bank + release on for A/B), with the smallest possible edit in p4atmos.ts; the waterline mist (`?atmoswl`), the massif veil (`?atmosveil2`), the bluer left bases (`?atmosblue2`) stay ON. Prove: int2 default at the hold (p06, p07) == int2 with `?fogbank=r11` in the old sense, i.e. the hold bank equals int1's (compare the bank region pixels vs :5173 at p06 / p07 at the same sim state).
STEPS: (1) cp -c -R LANES/int1 LANES/int2 (verify int1 app == MAIN app with diff -r). (2) Verify each patch reproduces its lane from its base; then per file git merge-file -p <int2 file> <base file> <lane file>, lane by lane (water, ice3, orb3, env3, atmos); resolve conflicts by hand keeping both intents; copy new files + assets. (3) The fogbank default flip. (4) tsc clean. (5) Serve int2 on :5179 (PORT=5179 nohup node hero-lab/serve.mjs --no-watch). (6) Switch proofs with ident vs :5173 (int1 = MAIN): ?p4water... note the water lane's own master switch name from its HANDOFF; all new lanes' master switches off == :5173 at T1, T2, T0 phone, ?envlake=plate and the hold poses p04 / p06 / p07; each lane's key effect survived (orb F402 figure, ice q01 / q02 seams, env far-peak rim gone + J5, atmos waterline mist at the iceberg base, water glint). (7) Perf: real-loop interleaved A/B int2 vs :5173 (rest, move, hold; >= 6 pairs; SLOT_BG=0; load < 10) plus time-to-heroReady (env3's start-up depth bake adds 80-180 ms: measure it; if it is on the critical path, defer it to after the first frame (idle callback) with proof that the first frames are unaffected, or report). (8) The full panel capture set: zsh /Users/muhamadrifaldi/RetruxR11Work/hp/qc_r11.zsh $SP/p3/r11_3 http://localhost:5179 T1 1, back it up with cp -c -R to ~/RetruxR11Work/p3caps/r11_3, and LOOK at cmp_q00_rest, cmp_q03_eye, cmp_p05_expand, cmp_p06_sustain, two pointer spots. (9) int2_vs_main.patch (diff -u --label a/retrux-web/<f> --label b/retrux-web/<f> against LANES/int1, all changed + new files), apply-test on a fresh int1 clone (0 .orig / .rej, reproduces int2 app/, tsc clean), list binary assets separately. Leave :5179 running. Never edit MAIN or any other lane.
args.verifier: ROLE: independent VERIFIER of integration 2 (lane int2, lab :5179; read-only, never restart :5179 / :5173). Time box 45 min. Folder $SP/work_p4/verify_int2; mirror into MAIN/notes/round11/lane_backup/p4int2/verify/. Check: the switch proofs (re-run the all-new-lanes-off ident yourself vs :5173 at T1 and T0); the fogbank default flip (int2's hold bank == int1's at p06 / p07, and ?fogbank=p4 shows the new bank); each lane's effect survived and nothing of another lane broke it (crops int2 vs each lane's final captures in $SP/work_p4/<lane>/qc_fix or qc_final, and vs MAIN's $SP/p3/r11_2); a glitch hunt on $SP/p3/r11_3 (10 pointer spots + the sweep, contrast-stretched zooms where the panel found glitches); console 0; tsc; the patch applies to a fresh int1 clone and reproduces int2; perf and heroReady re-measured once. ok = true only if no blocker / major and every switch proof holds. Look at every image you cite.
